Thank you for that question. Looking at the live net and the prepared workpiece together, I can clarify what's at stake.

In Petri net terms, reserving a crew member would mean consuming a token from the Dispatch crew available place when you start final inspection, holding it while the batch is under inspection, and returning it at sign-off. That would be represented by adding an input arc from Dispatch crew available into the Start final inspection transition.

Right now, the live net does not have that arc. The sequence runs:

A batch enters inspection (consuming from Batch ready)
After sign-off, the batch reaches Ready for dispatch and one crew token returns to Dispatch crew available

So currently, the crew is available whether inspection is happening or not—it's just returned at the moment of sign-off.

To figure out whether that arc belongs in your model, I need to understand the operational reality:
